decisionsTitle: «Mută pe lista de elită»: a line of the internal list becomes a name on the race's elite list, with no address
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-11-03**, of an elite runner the club had written on «Lista internă (doar notițe)» (§854) without an address: «având în vedere că e elită, nu trebuie să-i pun email». Until now a line could only become a registration (§888), and a registration needs an address.

**Decision.**

- **«Mută pe lista de elită»**, a third verb on every line of the internal list, beside «Mută pe lista oficială» and «Oferă-i un loc acum» (§888): the line's first and last name go onto the race's elite list, «Elită — doar numele pe BIB» (§895) — a name printed on a bib where the number goes — and the line is deleted. **Not a registration**: no participant, no place, no queue, no email, no declaration, so no address is asked, whether the line has one or not, and the declaration rule stays whole (CLAUDE.md's table, `AGENTS.md` §10.8).
- **The Administrator's alone** (`canManageRegistrations`), as writing the elite list (§895) and moving a line (§888) are: asserted at the action's door (`reserve-actions.ts#moveReserveEntryToEliteAction`) and again in the service (`reserve-list.ts#moveReserveEntryToElite`, BR-REQ-060-01). The Organizer keeps the internal list's add, note and delete and is drawn no button; Tehnic never reaches the registrations list. Drawn on every line and at any time — not only while the event takes a vouched entry, as §888's two verbs are: the elite list is no queue, and §895's own «Adaugă» has no such door.
- **One transaction**: the event row locked as `addEliteEntry` locks it (the lock every draw takes, `AGENTS.md` §10.6), then the line, then the elite line written and the line deleted. The name is the line's first and last name as the elite list stores one (`parseEliteEntry`: trimmed, inner spaces collapsed, 1 to 80 characters); a longer one — each of the internal list's two names may hold 100 — is refused in its own sentence, «Numele are peste 80 de caractere și nu încape pe BIB. Scrie-l mai scurt în editorul evenimentului, la „Elită — doar numele pe BIB”.» (`RESERVE_ELITE_NAME`), and nothing is written. **No number**: the editor's card gives one, with its checks (§895: a number is one person's). **The note is not kept**: an elite line stores a name and nothing else, and the address, if any, goes with the line. The trail, ids only: `event_elite.added` (`entryId`, and `reserveEntryId`, the line it came from) and `event_reserve.moved` (`entryId`, and `eliteEntryId`, the line it became). A second press finds the line gone.
- **Asked first** (§384), naming the person: «Îl muți pe lista de elită?» — «{name}: nu e o înscriere — niciun loc, niciun email, nicio declarație în aplicație. Pe BIB se tipărește numele. Nota internă nu se păstrează, iar rândul dispare de pe lista internă.» The button wears the elite list's medal (`elite`), 44 pixels, beside the line's other verbs, «Formularul complet: alte date, altă limbă» and «Șterge».
- **Where an address is asked** — under a line's «Email pentru lista oficială», the box §888 shows for a line without one — the Administrator reads «Alergător de elită? Nu-i trebuie adresă: „Mută pe lista de elită”.»: a line of its own under the box, not the box's help, which a refusal replaces with «Verifică acest câmp.».
- **After the press**: back to the registrations list as it stood — its filters, sort and page, from the form's `listQuery`; only the query travels and the path is rebuilt (§180's shape), the event always the line's — with the internal list open, the toast «Mutat pe lista de elită.» and, at the top of the panel, «Numele e pe lista de elită și se tipărește pe BIB. Nu e o înscriere și nu s-a trimis nimic.» with «Deschide lista de elită», a plain link to the editor's `/admin/events/[id]#bib-elite`, whose fold opens from the address (§336).

**Refused.**

- **An email made optional for a registration** — a staff entry, or «Mută pe lista oficială», with no address. The declaration rule forbids it: a registration needs the person's own approved declaration, signed from the email's link or on paper at the desk, and every email the queue sends; an elite runner whose bib carries their name needs none of that. An elite runner who also wants a place registers like anybody (§895).
- **Carrying the internal note onto the elite line**: the elite list stores a name and an optional number and nothing else (§895); the dialog says the note is lost before the press.
- **Choosing a number in the same press**: the number's checks are the editor card's (§895), and a second box in a dialog would repeat them.
changelogLine: - **«Mută pe lista de elită» on the internal list** — an Administrator moves a line of «Lista internă (doar notițe)» onto the race's elite list in one asked-first press: the name prints on a bib and nobody is registered, emailed or given a place, so no address is needed; the line and its note go, the list comes back as it was and links to the editor's elite card. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given a line of an event's internal list, with an address or without, when an Administrator presses «Mută pe lista de elită» and confirms its dialog — which names the person and says there is no registration, place, email or declaration in the app and that the internal note is not kept — then in one transaction, under the event row's lock, the line's first and last name is written on the event's elite list as `parseEliteEntry` stores a name (trimmed, inner spaces collapsed), with no number, and the line is deleted, audited `event_elite.added` and `event_reserve.moved` by ids only; no registration, participant, note or email exists for it; the press comes back to the registrations list with its query kept, the internal list open on a link to the editor's `#bib-elite`, and the toast «Mutat pe lista de elită.»; a name longer than 80 characters is refused in its own sentence and nothing changes; a second press finds the line gone. Verification: integration `registrations/reserve-to-elite.test.ts`, `registrations/reserve-to-elite-screens.test.ts` (2026-11-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

«Mută pe lista de elită» is the Administrator's alone: its button on each line of the internal list and the line under «Email pentru lista oficială» («Alergător de elită? Nu-i trebuie adresă…») are drawn for the Administrator only — the Organizer keeps the list's add, note and delete, Tehnic never reaches the registrations list — and an Organizer's or Tehnic's press is refused at the action's door and by the service, the line unchanged and nothing written. Verification: integration `registrations/reserve-to-elite.test.ts`, `registrations/reserve-to-elite-screens.test.ts` (2026-11-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
